extraction.notes: IRT reports an adjusted FFO metric named CFFO (CORE Funds From Operations) and no AFFO; affo fields are null. Starting line and all reconciling lines are from the three-months-ended March 31, 2022 column (seq 28, printed 14); seq 27 shows the same figures. Diluted shares: the FFO per share uses 'Weighted-average shares and units outstanding' of 227,778,484, shown in full, converted to thousands (227,778.484); it reproduces $0.26 FFO and $0.25 CFFO per share. Recurring capex of $3.9 million is from the Capital Expenditures paragraph (seq 5); it is rounded in the filing, so the 3,900 value is the printed $3.9 million expressed in thousands, not an exact figure. Totals foot: 76,880 + 77,943 - 94,712 = 60,111; 60,111 + adjustments = 57,710.
